scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof supported by independently recomputed finite cases. Literature comparisons are best knowledge, not proof of uniqueness or priority.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic is a first-order statement without a claimed effective error term. The exact coefficient identity used as a published premise is due to Merca. OEIS A192717 already covers the prime-congruent-to-three modulo eight portion of one branch; this theorem adds the complementary branch, square and dyadic cases and the global counting law. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Complete parity spectrum and prime-density law for signed two-block odd partitions
